alerts.disclaimer: These notes only describe what your own entries say — they are not a medical assessment. If you are worried, call your paediatric practice; when in doubt, rather once too early.

fewWetToday.detail: About six a day is the usual guide. A single day below that is mostly harmless; several in a row are worth asking about.
